description: Source code for the verify package in etcd, implementing data consistency verification including WAL and backend index validation.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration for verification, including data directory, index matching, and logger.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Performs data consistency verification on the specified data directory, including WAL and backend index validation.

methods.description: Performs verification based on environment settings if enabled.

methods.name: validateWAL
methods.description: Validates the WAL entries and retrieves the latest snapshot and hard state.
